# Lume Live

> Online career counselling, psychometric assessment and mental-health support
> for Indian students, parents and working professionals. Sessions are run by
> counsellors holding an M.Sc in Clinical Psychology. A first 1:1 session costs
> ₹249 (regular ₹499) — against a typical Indian market rate of ₹2,000–3,000 per
> session — and there are no compulsory packages.

Founded in Rohtak, Haryana; serves Delhi-NCR and all of India online.
Contact: hello@lumelive.co.in · +91-7015671280

## Mental health support and counselling

- [Online mental health counselling in India](https://lumelive.co.in/mental-health-counselling.html): the main page for 1:1 mental-health sessions — anxiety, exam stress, low mood, burnout, self-esteem. Confidential, online, run by a counsellor with an M.Sc in Clinical Psychology. First session ₹249 (regular ₹499).
- [Book a mental health session](https://lumelive.co.in/book-session.html): live calendar, same booking flow as career sessions.
- What is treated: generalised anxiety, exam and performance anxiety, low mood, academic burnout, work burnout, low self-esteem, career-related stress, parent–child conflict over studies.
- What is not treated: Lume Live is not a crisis service and does not prescribe medication. Anyone in immediate danger should call the Tele-MANAS national helpline on 14416 (India, free, 24×7).

### Mental health counselling by city

Sessions are online and available pan-India; the city pages exist for local context and local referral questions.

## Free mental health self-checks

All are free, private, need no sign-up, and store nothing. They are screening self-checks, not diagnoses.

- [All seven self-checks](https://lumelive.co.in/wellbeing-check.html): the index — anxiety, low mood, self-esteem, work stress, life satisfaction and flourishing.
- [Free anxiety test (GAD-7)](https://lumelive.co.in/free-anxiety-test.html): 3 minutes, the standard GAD-7 instrument.
- [Free depression / low-mood test (PHQ-4)](https://lumelive.co.in/free-depression-test.html): 2 minutes.
- [Free self-esteem test (Rosenberg scale)](https://lumelive.co.in/self-esteem-test.html): 3 minutes.
- [Free burnout and work stress test](https://lumelive.co.in/work-stress-burnout-test.html): 4 minutes, written for working professionals in India.
- [Free exam stress test](https://lumelive.co.in/exam-stress-test.html): 2 minutes, written for students before boards or entrances.
